# Document templates

- [SADD](sadd.md): whole-system architecture.
- [CDD](cdd.md): high-level component design.
- [Spec](spec.md): precise behavior or shared contract.
- [ADR](adr.md): consequential decision and rationale.
- [Task](task.md): substantial work, context, plan, and handoff.

Copy the relevant template to its destination, replace placeholders, fix relative links, and omit sections that do not apply. Keep documents proportional to their scope. Placeholder IDs in this directory are not allocated document IDs.
